item.title: Three Girls Vanished. A Letter Promised They’d Return.
item.description: Rachel Trlica, 17, Renee Wilson, 14, and Julie Moseley, 9, vanished while Christmas shopping in Fort Worth on December 23, 1974. A letter signed “Rachel” promised a return within a week. Her family questioned its authenticity, and FBI handwriting tests were inconclusive. All three remain missing.

item.title: The CIA Agent Behind Two Murders Never Existed
item.description: Billy Payne and Billie Jean Hayworth were killed in their Tennessee home in 2012. Investigators traced messages from a supposed CIA agent to Jenelle Potter’s household. Prosecutors showed she used the invented identity to encourage the killings. She and her parents were convicted of murder.

item.title: Christina Grimmie Opened Her Arms To Her Killer
item.description: Singer and The Voice finalist Christina Grimmie, 22, was fatally shot while greeting fans in Orlando in June 2016. A witness said she welcomed the gunman with open arms. Investigators uncovered his fixation on her and closed the case after his death by suicide.

item.title: She Missed Her Newscast. Police Found A Bent Car Key.
item.description: Iowa news anchor Jodi Huisentruit, 27, vanished before work on June 27, 1995. A bent car key, scattered belongings and drag marks near her vehicle led police to suspect abduction. She has never been found, and no one has been charged in her disappearance. Find Jodi Huisentruit

item.title: The Borrowed Jeep That Exposed A Murder Plot
item.description: Dallas dentist Kendra Hatcher, 35, was killed in 2015. A borrowed getaway Jeep led investigators to Brenda Delgado, her boyfriend’s ex. Delgado was convicted of arranging the murder and sentenced to life without parole in 2019.
